1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Inspect a three-ribbon weave with two marked crossings, a broad local lens, and a forgiving trace corridor. The route has only four control columns, so local over-under observations form a short trace plan.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Use the coordinate console to illuminate the short marked weave, then record its source-to-terminal route one coordinate sample at a time.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Hover to illuminate the short marked weave. Hold its source and steer continuously to the matching terminal without leaving the ribbon.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Follow one marked ribbon through a four-ribbon, five-column field and three crossings. Narrower illumination and tracing margins require a longer spatial plan than L1.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Use the coordinate console to map the marked ribbon through three crossings, then record the same route from source to terminal.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Map the marked ribbon through three crossings, then hold its source and continuously trace to the matching terminal.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Resolve four target crossings in a four-or-five-ribbon six-column field. The smaller lens requires more local observations and the trace must retain a denser path model.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Map enough local depth at the coordinate console to arm the source, then enter a monotonic sample record through the four marked crossings.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Use local hover illumination to resolve four marked crossings, then hold the source and trace the marked ribbon monotonically to its terminal.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Preserves the original task exactly: four to six ribbons across six control columns, at least five target crossings, the original local-lens radius, 18–22 px trace corridor, and original exploration and held-trace requirements.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Use the coordinate console to inspect local depth across the marked ribbon, then enter its complete monotonic source-to-terminal trace record before certifying it.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Use local hover illumination to inspect the marked ribbon and its over-under crossings. Once its source arms, press and hold there, follow the same ribbon monotonically through every crossing, release on its true terminal, and certify the routed signal.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Trace a six-ribbon, seven-column weave with at least seven marked crossings. A smaller local lens, dense route coverage, and a narrow corridor increase both depth reconstruction and continuous-control demands.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Use the coordinate console to reconstruct the dense seven-crossing weave, then record every ordered coordinate sample from source to terminal.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reconstruct the dense marked weave from local illumination, then continuously hold and trace its source-to-terminal route across every crossing without a breach.

simplified.summary: A visible X/Y coordinate console emits the same local illumination probes and records the same source, samples, release point, ordered crossings, timing, and replayed corridor rules without direct mouse tracing.

full.summary: Move the pointer directly to illuminate local depth, then press, hold, and steer it along the marked physical ribbon from source to terminal.
